enunciado: Implement the class LinkedStack with nodes (no capacity limit) and use it to reverse the order of the numbers 1 to 6 and to convert 156 to base 2.
objetivos: Implement a stack with linked nodes
Use a stack to reverse sequences
pistas: The top is the head of the list: push inserts at the front.
pop moves the head to its next node.
Remainders of dividing by 2 come out reversed: push them.
